calculation.description: Fade the completed three-session asset return. Scale the reversal by the prior completed cross-sectional daily return dispersion relative to its trailing 60-session mean and standard deviation; higher dispersion strengthens the fade and lower dispersion dampens it. All signal inputs are lagged or completed before portfolio decision time.

parameters.dispersion_definition: cross-sectional standard deviation of daily returns across tradable universe

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020, 2021, 2023, 2025, and 2026, but negative in 2022 and 2024. The daily gate passes, while predictive strength decays by ten sessions. Cross-sectional uncertainty is material because only 421 dates met the minimum and factor coverage is 31.77%. The signal is highly overlapping with a sparse volume-shock reversal artifact and requires screener de-duplication or a strict signal cap.
